people.name: Joshua Adam Gardner
people.bio_note: Financial advisor with prior roles at Summit Global Investments and Fidelity (Fidelity Brokerage Services LLC and Fidelity Personal and Workplace Advisors). Holds Series 63 and 65 licenses; registered to provide services in Arizona and Texas.
people.bio_source: Named independent source: SmartAdvisorMatch advisor profile (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/arizona/joshua-gardner-4495410), corroborated by GetWarmer advisor directory and firm site. Flag: SmartAdvisorMatch's detailed timeline shows Fidelity 2013-2023 (~10 years) and Summit Global Investments 2023-present, totaling roughly 10-13 years of tracked tenure — shorter than a '24 years of experience' figure previously carried in this bio, which has been removed as unconfirmed/possibly inflated rather than silently repeated.
